representation: Archived runes only, all headings included, no corrections or decryption; remove non-alphabet characters before assigning positions.
statistic: Pool matching ordered pairs across residue columns and divide by all within-column ordered pairs. Select the maximum across the listed periods.
null: Uniformly permute each archived transcription row independently, then concatenate rows in their original order. Preserve every row length and its rune multiset.
tail: greater than or equal, including ties
monte_carlo_p: (1 + null maxima at least observed maximum) / (1 + shuffle_trials)
limitations: Follow-up prompted by the published whole-page-shuffle baseline. One page and one changed null model; not independent confirmation or a correction for choosing among null models.
row_boundaries: Each nonempty text/lp2-31.txt line is one row. Remove non-alphabet characters within each row. Do not reset residue-column positions at row boundaries.
